scope: Four slots, one to four active objects, maximum height two
group_rule: Object count, source level, destination level, ascending other-slot counts; invariant to ID and slot permutation
pilot_exclusion: Pilot episodes may guide the teacher but must not enter model train, validation or test sets
source_interpretation: The same two direct teacher demonstrations inform the programmatic teacher across groups; held-out groups are unseen layout/task combinations, not independent original teachers
test_policy: Do not generate or inspect final test trajectories until policy architecture and training settings are fixed
